															Indian Army B.Sc Nursing 2026 Exam Pattern

															
																The General Intelligence and General English Test (ToGIGE) will consist of a computerized test (CBT) consisting of 40 MCQs of two marks each with a maximum of 80. Each wrong answer will carry a negative mark of 0.5 . These 40 questions will need to be answered in 30 minutes.
															
															
														
														
														
    
        
        📋 How to Apply for Indian Army AFMS B.Sc. Nursing Course Admission 2026

        
            Visit the official website joinindianarmy.nic.in.
            Click on the “B.Sc. (Nursing) Course 2026” or AFMS B.Sc Nursing Admission link (available after NEET UG 2026 result).
            Register using your valid Email ID and create a password.
            Fill the online application form with personal, educational, and NEET UG 2026 details.
            Upload required documents (photo, signature, etc.), pay the application fee (₹200 for General/OBC, Nil for SC/ST), and submit the form.
        

        Note: Application is open only for unmarried female candidates. Keep a printout of the submitted application for future reference. Contact the helpline for any issues.
